name: Advanced Playlist
description: Chapters for the video you are watching: a chapter list below the player and chapter marks on the timeline, from the chapters the video itself contains. Choose a chapter to go there. A video without chapters gets interval points instead, every 5 minutes by default (you can make them shorter or longer): generated positions, never chapters, paged a few at a time. On streams, and on local files Cinema reports it can read for previews (a plain local disk file), each point shows a thumbnail of the frame decoded at or after it (with that frame's own time), loaded for the points on the current page, after the timeline position you are hovering; on a local file Cinema hasn't verified (for example an MP4), choose a point to go there only while the player reports it as a plain local disk file it can seek, with a known length and its own uncorrected clock (otherwise the points are preview-only; the file's identity, chapters and editions stay unverified); choose a point to go there on verified local files, seekable progressive streams and direct plain MPEG-TS HLS VOD streams, where Cinema has checked that the player lands in the chosen segment. On every other HLS stream (masters, fMP4, byte ranges, encrypted, live) the points are preview-only. With Advanced Media, an Information panel shows what your library says about the title playing (matched only by its stated ids), including a link you confirmed there, shown as information only. With chapters you imported in Advanced Media for this exact file, a Supplied chapters list: choose one to move to its supplied time (never checked for accuracy). Chapters work without it. A queue of saved items: add from an item's details, play one, or choose Play queue to continue to the next item at a natural end (only for addons known to have no Up Next of their own). No skipping.

preferences.label: Interval points
preferences.help: For a video without chapters: how far apart the generated points are. Also changeable in the Chapters panel while watching; a change here applies the next time Chapters opens.
